_comment: Lasting effects (StatusEffectManager). 'turns' counts board turns. Effects are read by the board, minigames and views. 'combos' fire when two are active together.

rat_fever.name: RAT FEVER
rat_fever.desc: Lose a Dead Rat at the start of each turn.

paralytic.name: PARALYTIC
paralytic.desc: Sometimes you can't move at all.

hallucinogen.name: HALLUCINOGEN
hallucinogen.desc: Some squares aren't what they look like.

stimulant.name: STIMULANT
stimulant.desc: Three extra steps, then a turn you can barely move.

necrosis.name: NECROSIS
necrosis.desc: Something on you is going off. It gets worse.

memory.name: MEMORY LOSS
memory.desc: You won't know what game is next.

hunger.name: HUNGER
hunger.desc: Pay a Dead Rat each turn, or bite something you need.

combos.rat_fever+hunger: Accelerated rat loss: two more each turn.
combos.paralytic+necrosis: Your legs are going: two less on every roll.
combos.hallucinogen+memory: Nothing on the board can be trusted.
